statement: On the finite path a-b-z_1-...-z_(m-1)-c-d with t=beta J>0, original currents with sources ab and cd connect b to c with probability p^m, while independent sourceless augmentations of each source cluster meet with probability [1+m(1-p)]p^m, where p=tanh(t)^2. Thus no positive graph-uniform linear reverse comparison exists.
assumptions: Finite tree path, m>=1
Zero field and uniform ferromagnetic t>0
Four independently sampled random currents with sources ab, cd, empty, empty
source: owner-own-work: TREE_OBSTRUCTION.md; primary identities arXiv:2112.04248v3 eqs. (5.9), (5.13), (8.1)
proof_or_counterexample: Tree edge parity fixes independent even current edges; union of two even edges is present with p. Sum the disjoint possibilities for the left augmented cluster's first closed edge. Full proof in TREE_OBSTRUCTION.md.

statement: On the same tree, single source-current occupation at bridge distance m is (1-sech t)^m, while occupation after one independent sourceless augmentation is tanh(t)^(2m); the ratio is (1+sech t)^(-m). The augmented two-point occupation identity does not provide a graph-uniform lower estimate for single-current occupation.
assumptions: Same finite tree and current assumptions as L1
proof_or_counterexample: Every bridge edge is independently even in the single current and in its auxiliary current. Single presence is 1-sech t, augmented presence is 1-sech(t)^2. Multiply probabilities over edges; independence follows from tree parity constraints, not an unjustified conditional-product assumption.

statement: For the subcritical translation-invariant Z^3 Ising model, let mu(x)=G(x)/chi and Q_y be the average under independent X,W~mu of P^{0 triangle X,y triangle(y+W)}(0 connected to y in n1+n2). Then lambda=-g=2 xi_exp^(-3) sum_y Q_y. For Y uniform in B={||y||infinity<=floor xi_exp} and xi_exp>=1, lambda>=2|B|xi_exp^(-3)Q_B>=2Q_B.
assumptions: 0<beta<beta_c; zero field, nearest-neighbor unit ferromagnetic couplings
Translation invariance, chi<infinity
Standard infinite-volume sourced-current construction with switching identity
Source pairs cancel modulo two; tagged anchor vertices remain in connectivity event
source: owner-own-work: ATTEMPT.md L3; primary identity arXiv:1707.00520v1 Exercise61(1), arXiv:2112.04248v3 eq.(5.13)
proof_or_counterexample: Sum -U4=2G(x)G(z-y)q over x,y,z, substitute z=y+w and normalize by chi^2 xi^3. Absolute summability follows from sum -U4<=2chi^4 using the tree-diagram bound. Dropping y outside B gives the lower bound. Four-cycle exact spin enumeration checks all endpoint coincidences and the summed identity.

statement: With the joint law in L3 and Y uniform in B, set N=|B intersect C_0(n1) intersect C_Y(n2)| using ORIGINAL single-current components. Writing m1=E N>0 and m2=E N^2 gives lambda>=2|B|xi_exp^(-3)m1^2/m2. If m2<=C m1^2 uniformly near beta_c, liminf lambda>=2/C>0; a bounded-ratio subsequence gives the source's weaker limsup lambda>0 target.
assumptions: All L3 assumptions and xi_exp>=1
The stated uniform second-moment inequality ONLY for the conditional implication
proof_or_counterexample: A nonempty intersection implies 0 connected to Y in the current union. Cauchy-Schwarz on N times its nonzero indicator gives P(N>0)>=m1^2/m2. Combine with L3. m1>0 since Y=0 makes the anchored components meet. Exact four-cycle check validates the finite reduction.
remaining_gap: UCM: uniform m2/m1^2 for original current clusters is UNPROVED. This is a conditional reduction, not a solution of C0052.

statement: Let k(v)=sum_x mu(x) P^{0 triangle x}(v in C_0(n)) and k2(u,v)=sum_x mu(x) P^{0 triangle x}(u,v in C_0(n)) for one current. Then m1=|B|^(-1)sum_{v in B}k(v)sum_{y in B}k(v-y), and m2=|B|^(-1)sum_{u,v in B}k2(u,v)sum_{y in B}k2(u-y,v-y). Moreover G(v)/chi<=k(v)<=G(v), whereas adding a sourceless current makes k_aug(v)=G(v). Hence m1_aug/chi^2<=m1<=m1_aug, with m1_aug the same convolution using G.
assumptions: L3 translation-invariant subcritical endpoint law
Conditional independence of the two currents, not independence of hits within one current
Standard augmented-current occupation identity
source: owner-own-work: ATTEMPT.md L5; augmented identity arXiv:2112.04248v3 eq.(5.9)
proof_or_counterexample: Condition on endpoints, average independent current factors, and translate the second anchored cluster. Joint hits stay in k2. Average G(v)G(x-v)/G(x) against G(x)/chi to get G(v); enlargement gives the upper bound. The deterministic source endpoint X=v gives the lower bound. Both moment kernels and all occupation bounds passed exact four-cycle spin/current enumeration.
